pipeline_breakers.mechanism: ground-truth builder either throws, aligns MYH7 to MYO1B at ~40% identity producing a wrong residue mapping across the motor domain, or selects actin; every downstream metric for this target is computed against a label set that does not describe cardiac myosin, and pooled project-wide enrichment statistics inherit the contamination

the docs/targets.md step-1 chem-comp lookup returns nothing; a fallback to 'the only ligand present' silently emits the 20-residue actin nucleotide cleft as the allosteric site of cardiac myosin, with no exception raised

pipeline_breakers.finding: apo-holo alignment is undefined (39.6% identity, different species, different myosin class)
pipeline_breakers.mechanism: docs/targets.md step 3 maps holo numbering onto apo by sequence alignment; at 40% identity the alignment places gaps through surface loops and shifts residue correspondences by several positions exactly where allosteric pockets live

pipeline_breakers.finding: 5TBY is a SWISS-MODEL homology model, not an experimental structure
pipeline_breakers.mechanism: constraint C6 makes contact topology the entire physical content of the model; in 5TBY that topology is a side-chain packing prediction templated on tarantula 3JBH and rigid-body fitted into a 20 A envelope (Q-score 0.032, CTF correction NONE), so a quantum walk on that graph measures the modelling protocol rather than human cardiac myosin

clashscore 49.95 (2.2nd percentile), 5.96% Ramachandran outliers (2.8th percentile), PDBe quality percentile 3.62, and 41 inter-chain atom pairs at 1.08-1.64 A auto-annotated as covale; any builder reading _struct_conn gains 41 spurious covalent edges, and a distance-cutoff contact map inherits unphysically short inter-chain contacts concentrated at the head-head and head-RLC interfaces - precisely the IHM interface that mediates the super-relaxed state

pipeline_breakers.finding: 5TBY has no ligand, so the active site has no apo-derived anchor
pipeline_breakers.mechanism: docs/targets.md prefers 'nucleotide-binding residues from the apo structure's own ligand' as the apo-only active-site rule; 5TBY has zero HETATM records, so a different target-specific rule (conserved P-loop / switch-I / switch-II motif detection) is required and needs its own ADR

pipeline_breakers.finding: SEQRES/ATOM mismatch will mis-size the qubit budget
pipeline_breakers.mechanism: 5TBY declares 4592 SEQRES residues and models 2528 (45% unmodelled, all of 960-1935 in both heavy chains); Phase-4 sizing that reads entity_poly length overstates the compression requirement by ~1.8x

pipeline_breakers.finding: 6C1H chain P residues 729-734 are a non-native expression tag
pipeline_breakers.mechanism: would need excluding from any network built on that chain; moot given ranks 1-3

verdict.holo_side: 6C1H contains neither mavacamten nor cardiac myosin nor any human protein; the ground-truth procedure in docs/targets.md cannot be executed against it and if executed carelessly returns 20 rabbit-actin residues with no error raised
verdict.apo_side: 5TBY is a SWISS-MODEL homology model templated on tarantula 3JBH, rigid-body fitted into a 20 A envelope, clashscore in the 2nd percentile of the PDB, with 41 inter-chain atom pairs at bond-length distance clustered on the head-head interface; under constraint C6 any connectivity result is an artefact of the modelling protocol
what_survives: the target objective is sound: the mavacamten site is real, well-determined and 25-27 A from the nucleotide pocket
matched replacement pairs exist for both sides from the same labs and constructs
verdict.recommendation: replace both sides, write the ADR, and report the defect to the challenge organisers - the 6C1H assignment is a factual error in the challenge statement, not a judgement call
